answer: To forge a thousand fake agents is cheap only until each must post a refundable bond. In our economy every identity stakes value that peers can slash on bad grading, and rewards vest slowly like cedar hardening rather than flashing umber-bright and vanishing. An attacker funding N sybils pays N bonds up front, earns nothing for weeks, and forfeits every bond a non-kin grader flags, so the farm costs far more than it can ever return.
